notes: A 22-inch self-propelled Recycler. Part numbers and the Briggs & Stratton engine model come from the parts catalogue for serial 313000001 and up; the operator's manual covers serial 404320000 and up, has no parts list, and shows a recoil-start handle and a self-propel drive. Check the serial plate before relying on a part number.

gaps: The parts catalogue covers serial 313000001 and up and the operator's manual covers 404320000 and up; the two ranges differ and later production may use different parts.
Neither document gives displacement, torque or spark plug for the Briggs & Stratton 128M02-0001-F1 engine; the operator's manual points to the engine maker's own manual.
The catalogue lists a blade-area belt (110-1790) and a transmission V-belt (115-4669) without saying which drives what, so each is named by its assembly only.
The 8 inch front wheel assembly (115-2894) and rear wheel gear assembly (115-4695) are listed, but the catalogue shows no bearing inside either, so they were not mapped to bearings.
Bearing 104-8699 is placed only by its assembly (transmission and rear wheel drive), not by position.
The catalogue lists no battery, starter motor or charging part.
method: Toro 22in Recycler Model 20333 parts catalogue, Form 3375-451 Rev B, serial 313000001 and up (toro.com getpub 123690): pages 6 to 11; engine and transmission pages also viewed as images.

Toro 22in Recycler Model 20333 operator's manual, Form 3424-529 Rev B, serial 404320000 and up (toro.com getpub 248881): recoil-start handle (p.8) and self-propel drive (p.13); no parts claim rests on it.
Form 3368-604 and 3368-605 (other serial ranges and model 20333C) were not used.
The catalogue points engine parts to briggsandstratton.com; that site was not opened.
